description: Implementation of OfficeReadPlatformService responsible for retrieving office-related data from the database, including office details, transactions, and hierarchical relationships. It uses JDBC templates, row mappers, caching, and security context for access control.

classes.name: OfficeMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation to map SQL ResultSet to OfficeData objects.

classes.name: OfficeDropdownMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for dropdown list of offices.

classes.name: OfficeTransactionMapper
classes.description: RowMapper to map office transaction SQL result set to OfficeTransactionData.

methods.name: retrieveAllOffices
methods.description: Retrieves all offices in the hierarchy, with optional filtering and sorting based on SearchParameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllOfficesForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves all offices formatted for dropdown menus based on user's hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveOffice
methods.description: Fetches a specific office by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeWithExternalId
methods.description: Fetches an office matching the given external ID.

methods.name: retrieveNewOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new office with default values.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedParents
methods.description: Finds valid parent offices for moving or creating offices, excluding the specified office.

methods.name: retrieveAllOfficeTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all office transactions for the user's hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveNewOfficeTransactionDetails
methods.description: Provides default details for creating a new office transaction, including available parent offices and currencies.
